parts.label: Manual Transaxle Case
parts.function: The one-piece alloy case of the G81.20 6-speed manual transaxle, housing the gear train, shift mechanism, and final drive in a shared gear-oil bath.

parts.label: Bellhousing
parts.function: The bell housing at the engine end that encloses the flywheel and dry clutch and bolts the transaxle to the rear face of the engine.

parts.label: Dual-Mass Flywheel
parts.function: Two-mass flywheel that smooths crankshaft torque pulses before they reach the clutch, reducing gear rattle at idle and low rpm.

parts.label: Clutch Assembly
parts.function: Single dry clutch — the pressure plate clamps the friction disc against the flywheel to couple the engine to the input shaft, and releases when the pedal is pressed.

parts.label: Clutch Pressure Plate
parts.function: Diaphragm-spring pressure plate bolted to the flywheel that clamps the clutch disc; replaced together with the disc as a set.

parts.label: Clutch Friction Disc
parts.function: Friction disc with a sprung hub splined to the input shaft — the primary wear item of the clutch system.

parts.label: Clutch Release Bearing
parts.function: Release bearing riding on the slave-cylinder snout that presses the diaphragm-spring fingers to disengage the clutch.

parts.label: Clutch Slave Cylinder (CSC)
parts.function: Concentric hydraulic slave cylinder on the input-shaft axis that pushes the release bearing into the diaphragm spring when the clutch pedal is pressed.

parts.label: Input Shaft
parts.function: Splined input shaft on the centre axis, driven by the clutch disc and carrying the forward drive gears.

parts.label: Pinion / Lay Shaft
parts.function: Lay shaft below the input axis whose driven gears deliver the selected ratio into the final-drive pinion.

parts.label: Gear Set (6-Speed)
parts.function: Six helical forward gear pairs plus a reverse idler providing the G81.20's 6-speed ratio spread.

parts.label: Synchronizer Rings
parts.function: Blocker rings that match shaft speeds before each gear engages, giving smooth crunch-free shifts.

parts.label: Selector Rods and Shift Forks
parts.function: Selector rods and shift forks that slide the synchro sleeves into the chosen gear.

parts.label: Reverse Idler Gear
parts.function: Small idler gear that reverses the rotation direction for reverse gear.

parts.label: Shift Selector Unit
parts.function: External selector unit on top of the case where the two shift cables from the cabin work the select and shift levers.

parts.label: Shift Cables (Select + Shift)
parts.function: Pair of Bowden cables connecting the cabin gear lever to the selector unit on the gearbox.

parts.label: Selector Shaft
parts.function: Selector shaft dropping from the shift unit into the case to work the internal shift gate.

parts.label: Final Drive / Differential
parts.function: The final-drive gear set and differential that split torque between the two rear half-shafts.

parts.label: Final Drive Ring Gear
parts.function: Hypoid ring gear stepping the pinion-shaft output down to the final-drive ratio.

parts.label: Differential Carrier
parts.function: Differential carrier distributing final-drive torque between the rear wheels.

parts.label: Output Flanges (x2)
parts.function: Splined flanges on each side of the differential that accept the rear half-shaft inner CV joints.

parts.label: Output Flange Left
parts.function: Left-side drive flange connecting the differential to the left rear half-shaft CV joint.

parts.label: Output Flange Right
parts.function: Right-side drive flange connecting the differential to the right rear half-shaft CV joint.

parts.label: Rear Half-Shafts (x2)
parts.function: CV half-shafts transmitting final-drive torque from the output flanges to the rear wheel hubs.

parts.label: Gear-Oil Drain Plug
parts.function: Bottom plug on the case floor removed to drain the gear oil; replace the sealing washer at every service.

parts.label: Drain Plug Sealing Washer
parts.function: Crush-type sealing washer under the drain plug — single-use, replace whenever the plug is removed.

parts.label: Gear-Oil Fill / Level Plug
parts.function: Side plug used to fill and set the gear-oil level — fill until oil reaches the bore lip with the car level.

parts.label: Gear Oil
parts.function: Hypoid gear oil shared by the gearbox and final drive; drained at the floor plug and refilled through the side fill plug.

parts.label: Case Breather Vent
parts.function: Case vent that equalises internal pressure as the gearbox heats and cools, preventing seal blow-out.

parts.label: Transaxle Rear Mount (Hydro-Mount)
parts.function: Rear rubber hydro-mount supporting the gearbox tail and isolating driveline vibration from the chassis.

parts.label: Transaxle Mount Console / Bracket
parts.function: Bracket bolting the hydro-mount to the chassis subframe, carrying the transaxle's vertical and lateral loads.

parts.label: Reverse-Light Switch
parts.function: Switch on the case top-rear that closes the reverse-lamp circuit when reverse gear is engaged.

parts.label: Transmission Ground Strap
parts.function: Braided strap grounding the transaxle case to the body so starter and sensor currents have a return path.
